entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This atmosphere... Is this a Palace!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But, we never activated the Nav...
entries.uk: Але ж ми не вмикали Навігатор...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wait, do you think it was Yoshizawa!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She wasn't anywhere near us when we[n]slipped into this Palace...
entries.uk: Коли ми прослизнули в цей Палац,[n]її й близько біля нас не було...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She can't fight like we do.[n]We have to find her, fast!
entries.uk: Вона не вміє битися, як ми.[n]Треба знайти її, і хутко!
